title: Prefill and batching: where V100 actually loses
result: prefill 1776 tok/s at `num_batch=2048` against 587 at 128 and 1351 at default 512 - ×3 to 128 and +31 % to 512, on 1k, 8k and 16k the best is exactly 2048. On 16 440 tokens 1441 tok/s (−19 % to short). Conclusion: on V100 keep `num_batch=2048`.

title: Volta-fa patches for llama.cpp
result: Built llama.cpp with 4 of 8 patches (the rest did not apply - base-commit in the patches was not specified). Compared to Ollama: decode 70.65 against 65.8 tok/s (+7.4%), prefill 512 - 1822 against 1776 (+2.6%), prefill 4096 - 1663. The advertised +34–45% is not there; almost all the gain comes from FlashAttention itself (+8.7% to decode), not the patches. Conclusion: it's not worth leaving Ollama for a 7% improvement. Log: 22.11.2026.

title: GQA→MHA: quiet fallback attention in ComfyUI
result: Confirmed: GQA silently falls back to the math path on sm_70: 4.63 TF/s compared to 33.15 for MHA (×7.2), on 8192 math tokens it consumes 8 GB and crashes due to OOM. Expanding KV to MHA returns 31.9 TF/s. Our LTX/Wan/CogVideoX/SDXL are MHA, they are not affected; the rule is needed for GQA models (Qwen-VL, new video-DiT). Check: compare auto with forced MATH - if it matches, math has been enabled.

title: KV cache q8_0 → context 32–64k
result: q8_0 KV does not hurt retrieval quality (needle 3/3 on 6496 tokens, as with fp16) and at 16k provides twice the generation speed - 44 against 21 tok/s, plus 2 GB of free VRAM (11.6 against 13.6). But the ceiling for 14B on 16 GB is 32k context (16k prompt): 64k does not load even with q8. Part of the hypothesis about 64k is rejected.

title: System prompt KV cache
result: The prefix cache works in both llama.cpp and Ollama, but llama.cpp wins on tail editing. 2k prefix: cold 1047 ms, repeat 663 ms, tail edit 95 ms (recomputed 34 tokens). 6k: cold 1106 ms, repeat 186 ms against 1541 ms without cache - an 8x speedup. Ollama on the same prompts: first 967 ms, repeat 199 ms, but tail edit recomputes the entire prefix. Conclusion: enable cache in llama-server, fix the order of fields in the system prompt (date at the beginning breaks everything).

title: DRY-sampler and budget of reasoning
result: The DRY penalty did not reproduce on our model: on five regular tasks and two specifically designed to cycle (120 varieties of roses by numbers, 80 lines of log) the share of repeated 12-grams was 0.0 in all modes - both without DRY and with `--dry-penalty-last-n 1024 --dry-multiplier 0.8 --dry-base 1.75`. Cycling does not occur at all in qwen2.5-coder-14b with temp=0 on Russian tasks, there is nothing to treat. The cost of the mode is approximately 3% speed (67.1 vs 65.2 tok/s). Conclusion: keep DRY turned off, turn it on selectively if a specific model starts cycling; `--reasoning-budget` build accepts.

title: Video without RAM ceiling: clip length and 720p
result: RAM was not the limit: process RSS of 41.6 GB at all lengths, VRAM 12.7-13.0 GB. 480p (20 steps): 97/145/193 frames ok - 176/283/416 sec; 241 and 321 - OOM. 720p without tiling crashes during decoding after 394 sec (requires 1.72 GB, free 1.61); with VAE tiling, 97 frames take 594 sec at peak 13.55 GB, and 145 frames again OOM. Conclusion: the limit is a 16 GB card, not RAM; without tricks, 12 sec at 480p and 6 sec at 720p.

title: 32B dense and 30B MoE: re-measuring decode at 96 GB
result: The ceiling is at 16 GB of VRAM even with 96 GB RAM. Dense 32B Q4 (18.5 GB) model with 20 layers on GPU: prefill 253, decode 3.0 tok/s; at 40 and 99 layers llama-bench fails to load the model at all. MoE qwen3-30b-a3b (17.3 GB) with the same 20 layers: prefill 440, decode 24.5 tok/s - 8 times faster. Conclusion: among large models, only MoE can run on 16 GB VRAM; dense 30B+ models are not worth loading.

title: TTFT and model loading with warm cache
result: A warm page cache changes the picture dramatically. llama.cpp: cold start 22.4 s, warm repeat 3.2 s - 7 times faster. Ollama 14B: after offloading the model, 18.2 s and prefill 1155 ms on 1634 tokens, immediately next 0.2 s and prefill 69.5 ms (entire prefix from cache). Previous figures "14B loads in 16 s" are only valid for the first start after reboot; in working mode, loading is 3 s, and repeat TTFT is practically zero. Both values are entered as a standard.
